description: Source code implementing a CUDA host memory caching allocator with event pooling and thread management for PyTorch.

classes.name: EventPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of CUDA events per device to optimize event creation/destruction in multithreaded environments.

classes.name: CUDACachingHostAllocatorImpl
classes.description: Implements a CUDA host memory allocator with caching, registration, and thread pooling features.

methods.name: allocate_host_memory
methods.description: Attempts to allocate host memory, first from reserve segment, then via slow path.

methods.name: allocate_host_memory_slowpath
methods.description: Allocates pinned host memory, optionally registering it with CUDA, and updates stats.

methods.name: free_block
methods.description: Frees a memory block, unregistering if necessary.

methods.name: free_block_slowpath
methods.description: Handles freeing of host memory, unregistering if it was registered.

methods.name: record_stream
methods.description: Records a CUDA event on a stream for synchronization.

methods.name: query_event
methods.description: Checks if a CUDA event has completed.

methods.name: create_event_internal
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a CUDA event from the pool.

methods.name: get_reserve_segment
methods.description: Returns the reserve segment for host memory allocation.

methods.name: getThreadPool
methods.description: Returns a thread pool for parallel page mapping.

methods.name: mapPagesForRegister
methods.description: Pre-faults pages to prepare for cudaHostRegister.

methods.name: allocWithCudaHostRegister
methods.description: Allocates and registers host memory with CUDA, possibly in parallel.

methods.name: get_current_stream
methods.description: Retrieves the current CUDA stream, setting device context if needed.

methods.name: stream_is_capturing
methods.description: Checks if a CUDA stream is in capture mode.
